data.title: 芙莉莲 · 魔法书研究
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 魔法书研究】古老图书馆的高耸书架间浮动着微尘，悬浮的魔法阵在泛黄古籍上方散发出幽蓝的辉光。寿命逾千年的精灵魔法使推了推耳边的白发，专注地研读着失传的民间魔导书——「这是能把温红茶变成甜葡萄汁的魔法。虽然看似没什么用处，但辛美尔当年……一定会觉得很有趣吧。」
data.action: 在古籍与魔法阵光芒中研读
data.promptProse: Frieren studies an open folk-magic grimoire beneath a small blue magic circle at a table between old library shelves. She tucks silver-white hair behind a pointed ear, her staff resting beside the chair and her white hooded robe secured by its belt. The medium view follows shelf aisles behind her. Warm library light reveals paper edges, while blue rune glow illuminates the diagram and her attentive green eyes.
